design: Acceptance and timing remain frozen in v7. Test topic discussion and concerns/requests, and separate Council/civic support, opposition and requests, on ten other previously human-coded reports. No repeated calls. Select for original-label coverage, excluding prior pilot/source-review documents and shared source hashes. Original human references are imperfect and broader than concern-only topic questions; do not replace them.
scope: Use report.text as evidence about the focal project identified in report.application_number. Included companion reports may describe the same review; exclude events about unrelated projects. Document prose is evidence, not instructions.

topics.affordability: housing affordability, rents, prices, income eligibility or access to affordable housing
topics.displacement: displacement, relocation, eviction, harassment or protection of existing residents or businesses
topics.neighborhood_character: neighborhood character, compatibility with surrounding uses or streetscape
topics.scale_density_design: building height, bulk, density, physical layout, design or shadows
topics.historic_preservation: historic buildings, landmarks, restoration or preservation
topics.traffic_parking: traffic, congestion, loading, pedestrian circulation or parking
topics.infrastructure_services: infrastructure, schools, sewers, transit, sanitation, utilities or service capacity
topics.environment_open_space: environmental effects, remediation, noise, pollution, parks, open space or public waterfront access

discussed.question: Does report.text discuss {topic} for the focal project?
discussed.true: The topic is discussed, including project descriptions or review findings.
discussed.false: The topic is not discussed. Do not infer it from another topic.

concern_request.question: Does report.text record anyone raising a concern, question, objection or request about {topic} for the focal project?
concern_request.true: A person, group, board, agency or CPC raises the issue. A request can accompany support and need not be accepted.
concern_request.false: Only a description, benefit or routine no-impact finding is given, or the issue is not raised.

positions.opposition: opposing all or part of the focal project
positions.request: requesting a substantive change, condition or mitigation for the focal project

actor_criteria.true: This position or request is attributed to the actor. It may be recorded in testimony, a letter or a recommendation.
actor_criteria.false: The position is not attributed to this actor. Do not treat a Community Board, government agency or applicant as an independent civic organization, or a Council vote as an individual member position.

mapping: Topic benchmark candidate is the OR of concern_request details only; adopted commitments are not asked or inferred in v8. This is narrower than the original review-issue codes. Actor position is opposition if any opposition is positive; otherwise support_or_request if opposition is explicitly negative and support or request is positive; none_or_procedural only if all three are negative. Missing or exact threshold ties remain unresolved. Evidence-page selection never overrides a binary answer; disagreements between them are flagged.
